rationale: Good opening: hose check first, found and fixed the squashed hose, and unplug instructions were given before the filter/tube work. However the assistant ignored her stated refusal in turn 3 ('carefully open the flap and unscrew the filter'), then proposed gravity-draining via the back hose into a small tray on laminate before correcting itself, and the customer had to suggest the emergency drain tube herself. The closing turn jumps to an engineer and floats 'the pump itself has failed' without exploring the obvious alternative of a family member cleaning the filter or asking about pocket debris, so the likely cause (coins in the filter) was never reached despite the evidence pointing there.
